TIME Magazine Honors Nine Indian Athletes and Leaders on Inaugural Next India List

TIME Magazine has released its inaugural TIME100 Next India list, recognizing nine prominent Indian athletes and leaders. Among those honored are athletes Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Harmanpreet Kaur, and Mirabai Chanu. The list also includes Angh director Theja Rio and Pawan Kumar Chandana, highlighting future leaders from various fields.
